trigger: Plays upon breaching the sterile white lobby of Templatr HQ.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Templatr HQ. A windowless, soulless beige monolith standing at the center of Neo-Amritsar.

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Get a load of this place. Zero drip, zero personality, pure clinical beige.

lines.speaker: manya
lines.text: It's all #F5F5DC! I am going to splash this entire lobby in neon magenta!

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: Oh my god wtf bhai. It looks like an untextured default cube. Horrific.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: The master render drive is on the 99th floor! It's 8:30 AM! Thirty minutes left!

lines.speaker: sehaj
lines.text: Thirty minutes. Heavy lifting starts now. Vajj.
